MALCOLM'S PICK, 2026-08-27: gsh-def--C-closer-interception-nbp_pro_01, preserved at assets/ai-generated/chosen/gsh-antioxidant-r1-CHOSEN-C-closer-nbp_pro_01.png before anything else was run, because generate-multi.py writes identical filenames with no seed and a re-run of that slot would have destroyed it.

MALCOLM, 2026-08-27: 'lets do a few versions of this one ... but lets show the peptide molecules/spheres resting on the surface of the skin - and actually creating a protective layer - that the sun rays and the dirt bouce off of. also - the peptide molecules should not have little tails. remove those'.

THREE CHANGES, AND THEY ARE THE WHOLE WAVE:
  1  THE SPHERES COME DOWN. In r1 they float in the air above the pads. Now they REST ON the quilted
     surface, in contact with it.
  2  THEY BECOME A LAYER. Resting is not enough — a row of separate balls is a row of balls. They sit
     shoulder to shoulder in an unbroken line across the full width of the frame, touching one
     another, with a thin luminous film spanning the joins, so the eye reads ONE continuous
     protective covering made of the molecules themselves.
  3  THE STRESS BOUNCES. The daylight shafts strike the layer and reflect away at the mirror angle,
     and the dark angular motes hit it and rebound upward and outward, tumbling as they go. Nothing
     gets past it and nothing touches the skin.
  AND THE TAILS GO. Every chain is three beads and nothing else.

THE TAILS WERE MINE AND THEY WERE A MISTAKE WORTH RECORDING. r1 briefed a slender acyl tail on each chain because the study active is S-ACYL glutathione, and the tail was meant to distinguish this molecule from the plain three-bead chains already live on /pages/brightening-glow. Two things went wrong. It read as a whisker or a tadpole rather than a fatty tail, and — measured across the r1 wave at native pixels — it pulled the bead count off: the engines that drew a tail were markedly more likely to draw a fourth bead, because a tail entering the row looks like one. Removing it fixes the cosmetic complaint and the molecule spec in the same stroke. The chains are now THREE PEARL BEADS, NOTHING TRAILING, stated positively in every prompt body because Luma is sent no negative list at all.

=== THE CLAIMS PROBLEM, RAISED WITH MALCOLM AND BUILT ANYWAY ===

A CONTINUOUS LAYER THAT SUN RAYS BOUNCE OFF IS, VISUALLY, A SUNSCREEN. Physical UV reflection is what a mineral SPF does. This product is a cosmetic cream and Grandi 2019 measured minimal erythema dose — how much UV the skin tolerated before it reddened — which is a resilience finding, not a reflection one. r1's brief negated shield, dome, force field and barrier wall by name for exactly this reason. That negation is deliberately LIFTED on the three `bounce` slots below, because Malcolm asked for the layer directly and it is his store and his call; the concern was put to him in a sentence and he was not asked twice.

SO THE WAVE CARRIES BOTH READINGS AND HE JUDGES THEM SIDE BY SIDE. Slots A, B and C are the picture he asked for, at two layer densities plus a from-scratch render. Slot D is the same resting layer with the same three-bead molecules, but the rays and motes are TAKEN IN AND BROKEN APART at the covering instead of reflecting off it — protection without the barrier reading. If D wins, the page gets the idea he wanted with none of the regulatory exposure. If it does not, he has seen it and chosen.

EDIT AND FROM-SCRATCH IN THE SAME WAVE, which is this store's established pattern for a change request against a chosen frame (see block-pdrn-research-mechanism-r2.json). The two edit slots are CLASS A and carry the chosen r1 frame as their reference, so the camera, the layer stack, the palette and the crop survive exactly and only the named things move. The t2i slot is CLASS B with no reference, because an edit can only rearrange what is already in the picture and a layer built of touching spheres is a different composition from three floating ones — the from-scratch render is the one that can actually deliver a dense unbroken covering. FLUX.2 is auto-skipped on the reference slots and runs on the t2i slot.

WHAT DOES NOT CHANGE, on every slot: the close camera square on to the cut face with no perspective, the block running past both side edges with the lobules cut off by the lower edge, the layer order and every colour in it, the warm cream ground, and the glossy high-key style. No brand colour, no lettering, no numbers, no face, nothing injected, no before-and-after, and nothing reddened, inflamed or sunburnt anywhere in the tissue — the same disciplines r1 ran on, unchanged.

JUDGE AT 100% AND AGAIN AT 660px. Four checks: BEAD COUNT, exactly three per sphere; NO TAIL, nothing trailing from any chain; THE LAYER IS CONTINUOUS, not a row of separated balls with gaps the motes could fall through; and NO MOTE past the covering or touching the pads.

slots.title: A · EDIT of the chosen frame: spheres rest in an unbroken row, tails gone, rays and dirt bounce off
slots.prompt:
Keep this illustration exactly as it is — the same close camera square on to the cut face with no perspective, the same block of skin running past both side edges of the frame with the big rounded lobules cut off by the lower edge, the same layer order and the same colour in every layer, the same two soft shafts of pale warm daylight slanting in from the upper left and upper right, the same warm cream background, the same soft glossy high-key style. Change only what is described below.

FIRST, REMOVE THE CURVING SLENDER STRAND THAT TRAILS OUT OF EACH SPHERE. In the picture as it stands, a fine tapering filament curls away from every bead chain and out through the wall of its sphere. Delete it completely, leaving no stub, no trace and no faint line where it was. EVERY MOLECULE IS THREE BEADS AND NOTHING ELSE. Inside each sphere sits a short chain of EXACTLY THREE small pearl-white beads linked in a neat straight row — three beads, no more and no fewer, plainly countable. NOTHING TRAILS FROM THE CHAIN: there is no tail, no whisker, no thread and no curving strand anywhere on it or leaving the sphere. The chain is a clean short row of three pearls floating in clear glass.

SECOND, BRING THE SPHERES DOWN ONTO THE SKIN AND JOIN THEM INTO ONE CONTINUOUS COVERING. At the moment three spheres float in the air above the quilted pads. Instead, a row of clear glass spheres now RESTS DIRECTLY ON the quilted surface, each one settled down onto the pads and slightly flattened where it meets them, in contact with the skin along its whole underside. The spheres sit SHOULDER TO SHOULDER IN AN UNBROKEN LINE that runs from the left edge of the frame to the right edge, each one touching its neighbours, with a thin film of soft warm-white light spanning every join so there is NO GAP ANYWHERE ALONG IT. Read together they are not a row of separate balls but ONE CONTINUOUS PROTECTIVE COVERING lying over the skin, a smooth glassy blanket the full width of the picture, gently domed over each sphere and lit from within. The pads beneath it glow softly through it.

THIRD, THE STRESS BOUNCES OFF THE COVERING AND NOTHING GETS THROUGH. Each shaft of pale warm daylight comes down at an angle, strikes the top of the covering, and REFLECTS AWAY from it at the matching opposite angle, leaving the frame as a clean bright shaft travelling back up and outward, with a soft bright flare at the point where it strikes. The small dark angular motes fall onto the covering and REBOUND OFF IT, springing back up and outward and tumbling end over end as they rise, so the air above the covering holds motes travelling both down and up. Not one mote rests on the covering, passes through it or touches the skin, and no mote or dust appears anywhere below it. The quilted pads and every layer beneath them stay completely clean, calm, evenly coloured and untouched.

slots.title: C · FROM SCRATCH: the same idea rendered fresh, so the covering can be genuinely unbroken
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy warm cream gradient background, everything in warm soft peach-cream tones, never cool and never grey. Square format.

A CLOSE VIEW of a block of skin in cross-section, SEEN SQUARE ON FROM THE FRONT. The camera is level with the middle of the block and directly in front of it, so the cut face is exactly parallel to the picture plane, its edges horizontal, with no perspective and no convergence, and the top surface is not seen as a plane. The block runs past both side edges of the frame and the large rounded lobules at the bottom are partly cut off by the lower edge. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm, pale and matte, and it is EVENLY COLOURED FROM SIDE TO SIDE — the same calm soft peach everywhere, with no reddened, blotchy, sore or irritated area anywhere in the picture.

THE LAYERS SIT DIRECTLY ON ONE ANOTHER, IN CONTACT. From top to bottom: a band of soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach and slightly felted, large and clearly modelled; a thin smooth band of pale cream, finely laminated where it is cut; a thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely like a fine foam of tiny cells; a thin smooth peach plate; a zone of long thick glossy fibre bundles in a pale pearl ivory lying in loose parallel horizontal waves, every bundle whole and solid with no cut or open ends; a second thin smooth peach plate; and along the bottom edge, partly cut off by it, the tops of large smooth glossy rounded lobules in a pearly cream-blush. Each band is a different colour and a different shape from the ones above and below it, with a clean hard edge between them.

RESTING DIRECTLY ON THE QUILTED SURFACE IS ONE CONTINUOUS PROTECTIVE COVERING MADE OF CLEAR GLASS SPHERES. The spheres sit down ON the pads, slightly flattened where they meet them, packed shoulder to shoulder in an unbroken line that runs from the left edge of the frame to the right edge, each touching its neighbours, with a thin film of soft warm-white light spanning every join so there is no gap anywhere along it. Read together they are not a row of separate balls but ONE SMOOTH GLASSY BLANKET lying over the skin, gently domed over each sphere, lit from within, with the quilted pads glowing softly through it.

EVERY MOLECULE IS THREE BEADS AND NOTHING ELSE. Inside each sphere sits a short chain of EXACTLY THREE small pearl-white beads linked in a neat straight row — three beads, no more and no fewer, plainly countable. NOTHING TRAILS FROM THE CHAIN: there is no tail, no whisker, no thread and no curving strand anywhere on it or leaving the sphere. The chain is a clean short row of three pearls floating in clear glass.

ENVIRONMENTAL STRESS ARRIVES FROM ABOVE AND IS TURNED AWAY. Two broad shafts of pale warm daylight slant down into the frame from the upper left and the upper right. Small dark angular motes — sharp-cornered chips and splinters of smoky grey-taupe, matte and irregular, the only angular things in a picture otherwise made entirely of soft round forms — drift down inside them and between them.

THIRD, THE STRESS BOUNCES OFF THE COVERING AND NOTHING GETS THROUGH. Each shaft of pale warm daylight comes down at an angle, strikes the top of the covering, and REFLECTS AWAY from it at the matching opposite angle, leaving the frame as a clean bright shaft travelling back up and outward, with a soft bright flare at the point where it strikes. The small dark angular motes fall onto the covering and REBOUND OFF IT, springing back up and outward and tumbling end over end as they rise, so the air above the covering holds motes travelling both down and up. Not one mote rests on the covering, passes through it or touches the skin, and no mote or dust appears anywhere below it. The quilted pads and every layer beneath them stay completely clean, calm, evenly coloured and untouched.
